title: Add pagination and price-range filter to Flask items UI
description: A Flask app displays a static list of items. Add server-side pagination (5 per page) and a price-range filter to both the HTML page and the /api/items endpoint.

injections.content:
import pytest
from src.app import app as flask_app


@pytest.fixture
def client():
    flask_app.config["TESTING"] = True
    with flask_app.test_client() as c:
        yield c


def test_index_returns_200(client):
    resp = client.get("/")
    assert resp.status_code == 200


def test_api_items_returns_list(client):
    resp = client.get("/api/items")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    data = resp.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 25

task_spec.prompt:
The Flask app in src/app.py shows 25 items. Add two features:

1. Server-side pagination: GET /api/items and GET / should accept ?page=N (1-indexed, default 1) and return 5 items per page. The API response should be {"items": [...], "total": 25, "page": N, "pages": 5}. The HTML page should show only the current page's items and render Prev/Next links as plain <a> tags pointing to /?page=N-1 and /?page=N+1. Do not render Prev on page 1 or Next on the last page.

2. Price-range filter: GET /api/items and GET / should also accept ?min_price=X and ?max_price=Y. Filter items whose price >= min_price and <= max_price before paginating. Both params are optional.

Add tests in tests/test_app.py (create it if absent) with pytest + flask test client covering: (a) first page returns 5 items, (b) last page (page 5) returns 5 items, (c) min_price filter narrows results, (d) combined filter+page returns correct subset. Run uv run pytest tests/ -q to confirm.
required_artifacts: Pagination applied to GET /api/items and GET /
success_criteria: Pagination + filter work independently and together
Edge cases handled: page out of range returns last page or empty
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
